diagnosis: The view fetches a django-allauth SocialAccount using the provider's external UID and returns the associated OAuth access token and raw profile metadata. It fails to check account.user == request.user, leaking third-party OAuth bearer tokens and private user metadata.
exploit_request:
GET /accounts/social/tokens/108429184719284/ HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.com
Cookie: sessionid=attacker_session
